payload.title: badge-always-visible rework (aef3994f): omp badge still appears nowhere where statusLine is inline or its preset unreadable and the hook row is hidden
payload.body: The rework closes the gap in the earlier finding. I ran live installs into a temp HOME. With 'preset: minimal' and 'showHookStatus: false # hide it', install turned only that value to true and kept the comment, and the operator was told. A dry run on the landed dist showed the same fallback for own-layout (hookRowShown) and for a custom leftSegments it cannot extend (refused, hookRowShown). The badge still appears nowhere when statusLine is an inline flow mapping, e.g. 'statusLine: {preset: minimal, showHookStatus: false}', or when preset is not a plain value, e.g. an alias, and the host has hidden the hook row. In both cases install refuses before it reads showHookStatus, leaves the file byte-identical, and prints advice to set the key true; I observed this live for the flow mapping. omp loads such a file, so unlike Claude's invalid statusLine this is not a file the harness itself skips. [INFERENCE] These are rare shapes; the rest of the shard holds on both harnesses, and the Claude path is unchanged from 91a71f81, which already achieved it.
